lines.en: label karinspring7:
scene sky
Some people say that enduring stressful situations together is enough to make people closer. But I don’t believe them.
lines.zh: 有人说，一起熬过压力重重的处境，就足以让人变得亲近。但我不信。

lines.en: I think what really brings people closer together is experiencing the mundane. Those moments where nothing is really happening at all and you can just sit around and exist.
lines.zh: 我觉得真正让人亲近的，是共同经历那些平淡无奇的东西。那些什么都没发生的时刻，你们就那么坐着，存在着。

lines.en: That’s why we’re close, you and I. And why we’ll stay that way forever since I slip away at the first sign of conflict.
lines.zh: 所以我们才亲近，你和我。也所以我们会一直这样下去，因为一有冲突的苗头，我就会溜走。

lines.en: It’s just because I don’t want to be tainted. And I don’t want my time with {i}you{/i} to be tainted either since we only have so much of it.
lines.zh: 只是因为我不想被玷污。我也不想和{i}你{/i}共度的时光被玷污，毕竟我们拥有的时间是那么有限。

lines.en: So to me, those stressful situations don’t do much but spell the inevitable downfall of a relationship.
lines.zh: 所以对我来说，那些压力重重的处境做不了别的，只会预示一段关系必然的崩塌。

lines.en: Or predict things like the departure of friends after high school or the suicides of brothers in arms who can’t get ahold of how life feels when it’s not surrounded by death.
lines.zh: 或者预示另一些事，比如高中毕业后朋友的离散，比如那些战友们——他们摸不透不被死亡包围时生活是什么感觉——最终选择了自杀。

lines.en: We don’t have to worry about death today, though. This is a normal town full of normal things. And anything sad is simply just...excluded from the story.
lines.zh: 不过今天我们不用担心死亡。这是一座充满寻常事物的寻常小镇。而任何悲伤的东西，就只是……被排除在故事之外。

lines.en: One thing, though — if it ever feels like I’m lying, it’s probably because I am. And there’s probably a reason for that.
lines.zh: 不过有一件事——如果你觉得我在撒谎，那大概我就是在撒谎。而那大概是有原因的。

lines.en: But what’s it to you?
lines.zh: 但那与你何干？

lines.en: What’s {i}anything{/i} to you?
lines.zh: 又有{i}什么{/i}是与你相干的呢？

lines.en: You’re not even here. And neither am I. So the fact that we’re doing this at all is kind of uncalled for, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 你根本不在这儿。我也不在。所以我们居然在做这件事，本身就有点多余，不是吗？

lines.en: It’s never fun seeing just one side of the coin, though. And imagining what would happen if things were to play out in opposite fashion is sort of just an inevitability, I think.
lines.zh: 不过只看到硬币的一面从来都不好玩。而想象事情若以相反的方式展开会怎样，我觉得多少是一种必然。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom1
Which brings us here — to the outside of the Arakawa family household, where Karin Kanda is once again visiting a man who almost raped her.
lines.zh: 于是我们来到了这里——Arakawa 家门外。Karin Kanda 又一次来拜访那个差点强暴了她的男人。

lines.en: So today, we’ll bear witness to a fictional scenario in which {i}she{/i} was the one who flashed him her panties in his office and then subsequently threw her virginity away in a love hotel.
lines.zh: 那么今天，我们将要见证一个虚构的场景：在那个场景里，是{i}她{/i}在他办公室里掀开裙子露出内裤，随后在一家爱情旅馆里把自己的处女之身随手丢掉。

lines.en: Just, one more thing.
lines.zh: 只是，还有一件事。

lines.en: If it ever feels like I’m lying-
lines.zh: 如果你觉得我在撒谎——

lines.en: You know the rest.
lines.zh: 后面的你都知道了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom2
: Sensei? Are you home? It’s Karin. And I promise I’m not here to make you feel bad again. At least...not on purpose. But it will probably happen anyway since I’m still kind of mad at you.
lines.zh: : Sensei？你在家吗？是我，Karin。我保证这次不是来让你难受的。至少……不是故意的。不过大概还是会让你难受，因为我还是有点生你的气。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom3

: Which I probably shouldn’t be anymore after everything I’ve heard about your apparent {i}episodes{/i} lately. But it’s still my safety we’re talking about, so I can’t help but feel weird about this.
lines.zh: : 听说了你最近那些{i}「发作」{/i}的事之后，我大概不该再生气了。但这毕竟关系到我的人身安全，所以我还是会觉得别扭。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom4
: {i}Very{/i} weird actually. Maybe this was a bad idea after all? And maybe you’re not home and I’m just speaking into the void right now.
lines.zh: : 其实是{i}非常{/i}别扭。也许这本来就是个坏主意？也许你根本不在家，而我正对着虚空自言自语。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom5
: But in the event that I’m {i}not{/i} doing that and you’re actually listening to me on the other side of the door, I swear I’m not crazy! Even if it...feels like I am sometimes.
lines.zh: : 但万一我{i}不是{/i}在对着虚空说话，而你真的在门的另一边听着，我发誓我没疯！就算有时候……连我自己都觉得我疯了。

lines.en: : I just really want to talk to you about something, so...please let me inside! Or come outside!
lines.zh: : 我只是真的很想跟你谈点事，所以……请让我进去！或者你出来！

lines.en: : In fact, please do one of those things immediately or I will have to leave and never show my face around here again.
lines.zh: : 事实上，请立刻做其中一件，否则我就得走了，而且再也不会在这里露面。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom6
: Also, I...made cookies again. For my parents. But I brought you a few extras as a sort of gift or...bribe for what I’m going to ask you to do if you open the door. If you’re...even there.
lines.zh: : 还有，我……又做了饼干。是给我爸妈做的。但我多带了几个给你，算是礼物，或者……贿赂——如果你开门的话，我要求你做的事得靠它。如果你……真的在里面的话。

lines.en: : What kind of cookies did you make?
lines.zh: : 你做了什么饼干？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom7
: Oatmeal raisin. It’s my grandma’s recipe and-
lines.zh: : 燕麦葡萄干。是我奶奶的配方，还有——

lines.en: scene karinamiroom8
: Wait, Ami? What are you doing here? You live in there. And you are outside. Which is also where I am.
lines.zh: : 等等，Ami？你在这儿干什么？你住在里面。可你现在在外面。而我也在外面。

lines.en: : I went to the market down the road for some tea and produce since we were out. What are you doing at my house? You’re not on the list.
lines.zh: : 家里茶叶和菜没了，我去路那头的市场买了点。你在我家干什么？你又不在名单上。

lines.en: : You have a guest list for your house?
lines.zh: : 你家还有访客名单？

lines.en: : I never said it was a guest list.
lines.zh: : 我又没说那是访客名单。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom9
: Well...what kind of list {i}is{/i} it then?
lines.zh: : 那……那{i}是{/i}什么名单？

lines.en: : Let’s just say it’s a list of girls that my dad regularly {i}tutors.{/i}
lines.zh: : 就当是一份我爸定期{i}辅导{/i}的女生名单吧。

lines.en: : Is my sister on that list? She’s always struggled when it comes to history.
lines.zh: : 我妹妹在上面吗？她历史一直不太好。

lines.en: : Oh yeah. She’s on it, alright. I don’t think you have to worry about her education at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，在。她当然在。我觉得你完全不用担心她的学业。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom10
: Is he home by any chance? Or have I really just been speaking into the void for the last few minutes?
lines.zh: : 他碰巧在家吗？还是说我这几分钟真的只是在对着虚空说话？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom11
: I don’t know. He wasn’t here when I left. Let me check my tracking app.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我出门时他不在。让我查一下定位 app。

lines.en: : You can track his location?
lines.zh: : 你能定位他？

lines.en: : Yeah. Can you not do that with your dad?
lines.zh: : 能啊。你不能这样定位你爸吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure why I’d want to.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白我为什么要这么做。

lines.en: : Weird. Next, you’re going to tell me you’re not attracted to him either.
lines.zh: : 真怪。接下来你是不是要告诉我，你对他也没那种感觉？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom12
: I...I’m not.
lines.zh: : 我……我没有。

lines.en: : Am I...supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 我……应该有吗？

lines.en: : This is an...odd time for silence.
lines.zh: : 这个沉默的时机……有点怪。

lines.en: : Do you want to come in and hang out for a little while? It looks like he should be back in an hour or so.
lines.zh: : 要不要进来待一会儿？看起来他大概一小时左右回来。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom13
: Hah...thank you for the tea, Ami. I needed this. My sleep schedule has been all sorts of chaotic lately between club, exams, and an almost complete revision of my moral code.
lines.zh: : 哈……谢谢你给的茶，Ami。我正需要这个。最近我的作息乱得一塌糊涂——社团、考试，还有一次几乎彻底的道德准则修订。

lines.en: : I get that. The moral code thing I mean. I basically trashed mine years ago when I realized it was easier to live without one.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我是说道德准则那部分。我几年前基本就把它扔了，因为我发现没有它活起来更容易。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom14
: Yes, I’ve...heard some stories about your...shift in personality from my sister. You’ve always been so nice to me, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……从我妹妹那儿听过一些关于你「性格转变」的事。不过你对我一直都很好。

lines.en: : You’ve never given me a reason {i}not{/i} to be.
lines.zh: : 你从来没给过我{i}不{/i}对你好的理由。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like I have anything {i}against{/i} anybody. I’m just exceedingly true to {i}myself{/i} and I can’t help if that makes some people uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 再说，我也不是跟谁{i}过不去{/i}。我只是对{i}自己{/i}极其诚实，如果这让某些人不舒服，那我也没办法。

lines.en: : I wish I could do that. Because I’ve also realized lately that I’m caught in a permanent loop of doing things for other people that is slowly chipping away at both my happiness and sanity.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我也能那样。因为我最近也意识到，我陷进了一个为别人做事的死循环里，它正一点点削掉我的快乐和理智。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom15
: Well, the first part to changing anything will always be admitting it. And if you understand that now, you should be able to do something about it. Right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，改变任何事的第一步，永远是承认它。既然你现在明白了，你应该能做点什么吧？对吧？

lines.en: : Maybe under normal circumstances...and even then, I think I’d struggle.
lines.zh: : 也许在正常情况下可以……即便如此，我觉得我还是会很挣扎。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom16
: I’m not here to talk about myself, though. I’m here to talk about Kirin.
lines.zh: : 不过我不是来谈我自己的。我是来谈 Kirin 的。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to talk about Kirin. She likes my dad too much.
lines.zh: : 可我不想谈 Kirin。她太喜欢我爸了。

lines.en: : Yes, that is specifically what I want to talk about. I just assumed I’d be talking to Sensei directly instead of his...daughter.
lines.zh: : 是的，我要谈的就是这个。我只是以为我会直接跟 Sensei 谈，而不是跟他的……女儿。

lines.en: : Are you going to, like...tell him not to see her anymore or something?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是……要叫他别再见她了吧？

lines.en: : Because I could do that for you normally, but I’m trying to be less suffocating lately and I don’t think he’d believe me if I said it was actually a request for you. So if I could just get that in writing-
lines.zh: : 因为换作平时我可以替你做，但我最近在努力不要那么令人窒息，而且如果我说这其实是你提的要求，他大概不会信。所以要是你能给我个书面——

lines.en: : That’s not it. If Kirin found out I told Sensei to stay away from her, she’d kill me. I just...I want to see how {i}he{/i} feels.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。如果 Kirin 知道我叫 Sensei 离她远点，她会杀了我的。我只是……想知道{i}他{/i}是怎么想的。

lines.en: : I see. Well, I have no idea how much you know or {i}think,{/i} so I’m just going to keep my mouth closed and nod.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。嗯，我不知道你知道多少、{i}想到{/i}哪一步，所以我就闭嘴点头好了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom17
: Ami...your dad’s a popular guy, right? Like, some of the girls in {i}my{/i} grade talk about him sometimes and I don’t even think they’ve met him.
lines.zh: : Ami……你爸很受欢迎吧？就像，{i}我们{/i}年级有些女生有时会谈起他，我觉得她们甚至都没见过他。

lines.en: : Well, he {i}is{/i} the only guy around. And girls our age are obviously going to feel certain things given the...{i}changes{/i} we’re going through.
lines.zh: : 嗯，毕竟他{i}是{/i}这附近唯一的男人。而我们这个年纪的女生，鉴于正在经历的……那些{i}变化{/i}，显然会产生某些感觉。

lines.en: : So it only makes sense they would direct those feelings toward someone as handsome and perfect and cool as my dad.
lines.zh: : 所以她们把那些感觉投向我爸这样一个英俊、完美又酷的人，也就顺理成章了。

lines.en: : He is...certainly handsome. But {i}perfect?{/i} Is there really nothing about him that you dislike? No...negative aspects or...{i}attitudes{/i} or...habits?
lines.zh: : 他……确实英俊。但{i}完美{/i}？他身上真的没有什么你讨厌的地方吗？没有……负面的地方，或者……{i}态度{/i}，或者……习惯？

lines.en: : Hmm...nothing I can say to you, I think. You’re too much of a good girl.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我觉得没什么能跟你说的。你太像个好女孩了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom18
: What do you mean? I’m not entirely good. I can do bad things. And I can certainly {i}hear{/i} bad things.
lines.zh: : 什么意思？我又不是完全的好女孩。我也会做坏事。而且我肯定也{i}听得进{/i}坏话。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom19
: I’m sure you can. But nobody will ever forgive me if {i}I’m{/i} the one to corrupt you. And I’ve got a bad enough reputation as-is.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}相信你能。但如果带坏你的人是我，没人会原谅我的。而且我名声本来就够差了。

lines.en: : So you’re just going to have to tell me about these apparent “habits” of his you dislike on your own if you want to talk about them.
lines.zh: : 所以你要是想谈他那些所谓的「习惯」，就得自己开口告诉我是哪些。

lines.en: : I just...I don’t know. I don’t exactly feel safe around him is all. But Kirin {i}does.{/i} And that obviously makes me worried since it’s not a thing we see eye to eye on.
lines.zh: : 我只是……我不知道。我只是觉得在他身边不太安全。但 Kirin {i}觉得安全{/i}。而这显然让我担心，因为这恰恰是我们看法不一致的地方。

lines.en: : Why don’t you feel safe with my dad? You guys used to hang out a lot, didn’t you? I saw you in the park sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你为什么觉得跟我爸在一起不安全？你们以前不是经常见面吗？我有时候在公园看到过你们。

lines.en: : Yes, but — wait, you {i}saw{/i} us?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过——等等，你{i}看到过{/i}我们？

lines.en: : Yeah. Do you not stalk your dad when you’re curious about what he’s doing while he’s away from you?
lines.zh: : 嗯。你不好奇你爸不在你身边时在干什么吗？你都不跟踪他的吗？

lines.en: : Ami, {i}no.{/i}
lines.zh: : Ami，当然{i}不。{/i}

lines.en: : Wow. Next, you’re going to tell me you don’t have naughty dreams about him either.
lines.zh: : 哇。接下来你是不是要告诉我，你连关于他的色情的梦都没做过？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom20
: You...really {i}do{/i} idolize him, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……{i}真的{/i}很崇拜他，对吧？

lines.en: : Mhm. He’s the greatest thing that has ever happened to me. I’d marry him if he wanted me to.
lines.zh: : 嗯。他是我这辈子遇到过的最好的事。只要他愿意，我就嫁给他。

lines.en: : And you don’t...find anything strange about that?
lines.zh: : 你……不觉得这有什么不对劲吗？

lines.en: : It’s normal for girls to want to marry their dads.
lines.zh: : 女孩子想嫁给自己的爸爸很正常啊。

lines.en: : When they’re younger, I suppose that’s true. But you’re in high school now. I feel like...most girls have typically outgrown that desire by your age.
lines.zh: : 年纪小的时候，我想这没错。可你现在上高中了。我觉得……大多数女孩到你这个年纪，早就不再有那种念头了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom21
: Yes, well, as you may have noticed by the lack of even a training bra, I am a bit of an outlier when it comes to growth.
lines.zh: : 是啊，嗯，你大概也注意到了，我连小背心都用不上，所以在「发育」这件事上我算是个异类。

lines.en: : That’s a physical thing, though. That’s not what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 可那是身体上的事。我说的不是这个。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom22
: Easy for you to say. You’re already bigger than my mom was and you’re not even done growing yet.
lines.zh: : 你说得轻巧。你已经比我妈还大了，而且你还没发育完呢。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, I’m bigger than {i}my{/i} mom too.
lines.zh: : 如果这算安慰的话，我也比{i}我妈{/i}大。

lines.en: : Congratulations on being blessed. Please continue to assert superiority over me.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你天赋异禀。请继续在我面前秀优越感吧。

lines.en: : I’m not trying to assert anything. I just...if Kirin is going to be hanging out with Sensei, I want to make sure she’s safe. And even if I distrust him, I want to speak with {i}him{/i} about it.
lines.zh: : 我没想秀什么。我只是……如果 Kirin 要跟 Sensei 来往，我想确保她安全。就算我不信任{i}他{/i}，我也想跟他谈谈这件事。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom23
: Cool, yeah. Again, though, I’m going to need that in writing. I used up my last “overbearing daughter” card when I stabbed him in the hand.
lines.zh: : 酷，好。不过再说一遍，这个我得要书面的。我上一张「霸道女儿」卡，在我拿东西扎穿他手的时候就用完了。

lines.en: : I’ll just talk to him when he gets back. Assuming I don’t fall asleep beforehand. All these late nights are really weighing on me.
lines.zh: : 那我就等他回来再跟他谈。假设我到时候还没睡着的话。最近连着熬夜，我真的快扛不住了。

lines.en: : Can I get personal for a second, Karin? Like, we’re friends, aren’t we? We might not hang out all the time, but you’ve been here before. You know me.
lines.zh: : 我能问点私人的吗，Karin？那个，我们是朋友吧？我们也许不常见面，但你以前也来过。你了解我的。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom24
: I thought I did. But hearing you talk about your own father the way you have been is making me question just how much I really {i}know{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我以前以为我了解。但听你这么谈论自己的父亲，我开始怀疑，我到底真的{i}了解{/i}多少。

lines.en: : Then it’ll probably be easier if you just look at me as some random girl who lives with him instead of his daughter.
lines.zh: : 那你要是把我当成一个跟他住在一起的普通女孩，而不是他女儿，大概会容易些。

lines.en: : I feel like things would be even worse if you were a random girl who lived with him, but okay. I can try to do that if it helps.
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果你真是个跟他住在一起的普通女孩，事情反而会更糟，不过好吧。如果有帮助的话，我可以试试。

lines.en: : Perfect. So, just being completely direct, you’re attracted to him. Right? You called him handsome earlier.
lines.zh: : 很好。那么，直说了，你对他有那种感觉，对吧？你刚才还说他英俊呢。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom25
: I...do find him {i}physically{/i} attractive. But there’s a mental aspect to attraction as well and-
lines.zh: : 我……确实觉得他{i}外表{/i}有吸引力。但吸引力也有精神层面的，而且——

lines.en: : And he’s just too broken for you? Is that it?
lines.zh: : 而他对你来说太破碎了？是吗？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom26
: N-N-No! I don’t mind that at all! I just...have a hard time understanding his intentions. And, to me, they don’t seem very...{i}pure{/i} is all.
lines.zh: : 不-不-不是！我完全不介意那个！我只是……很难理解他的意图。而且在我看来，那些意图不太……{i}纯粹{/i}，就这样。

lines.en: : Because he’s an adult and you’re still in high school?
lines.zh: : 因为他是成年人，而你还在上高中？

lines.en: : Exactly. Yes.
lines.zh: : 没错。是的。

lines.en: : But wasn’t that not an issue until somewhat recently? Like, you pretty clearly had a crush on him for a while. What changed?
lines.zh: : 可这不是直到最近才成为问题的吗？比如，你明显曾经喜欢过他一阵子。是什么变了？

lines.en: : A lot. And they’re things I don’t particularly want to say out loud, so-
lines.zh: : 很多。而且那些事我不太想说出口，所以——

lines.en: : So you’ll just sit back and let your sister pursue him instead? Making this house-call more of a submission than a consultation. You should have shown up with a white flag if that was the case.
lines.zh: : 所以你就这么坐视你妹妹去追他？那这趟上门就更像是投降，而不是商议。要是那样，你还不如举着白旗来。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom27
: What? No, I-
lines.zh: : 什么？不，我——

lines.en: : {i}Unless{/i} coming here on behalf of your sister is just a pretense you’re using to put yourself into another situation where something happens between you guys. To which I’d say — wow. That’s bold.
lines.zh: : {i}除非{/i}你打着妹妹的旗号来，只是个借口，好把自己再次送进一个「你们之间会发生点什么」的处境。如果是那样，我只能说——哇。真有胆。

lines.en: : P...Pretense? What are you...since when do you even talk like that?
lines.zh: : 借……借口？你在……你什么时候开始这么说话的？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom19
: Since I stopped caring. Which you should do too, Karin. It’s way easier than whatever...{i}this{/i} is.
lines.zh: : 从我不在乎开始。你也该这样，Karin。这比……你现在{i}这样{/i}轻松多了。

lines.en: : And it would give you the only excuse you’d need to preserve your relationship with Kirin when you both wind up wanting the same guy.
lines.zh: : 而且万一你们俩最后想要的是同一个男人，它还能给你唯一需要的那个借口，好保住你和 Kirin 的关系。

lines.en: : Like, there’s no way she’d hate you for just having feelings of your own, right? Especially feelings the two of you both probably know about already.
lines.zh: : 比如说，她总不会因为你有自己的感情就恨你吧？尤其是那种你们俩大概早就心知肚明的感情。

lines.en: : I don’t...I don’t feel that way anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不……我不再有那种感觉了。

lines.en: : You brought him cookies, Karin. Yes you do.
lines.zh: : 你给他带了饼干，Karin。你就是有。

lines.en: : No I don’t! I just...had extras!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！我只是……多做了几个！

lines.en: : Just admit it. I’m not going to hold it against you for wanting to fuck my dad. Or, sorry, {i}roommate.{/i} In fact, if anything, I’d be offended if you {i}didn’t{/i} want to do that.
lines.zh: : 承认吧。你只想跟我爸上床——或者抱歉，我的{i}室友{/i}——我不会因为这个跟你过不去。事实上，要是你{i}不想{/i}，我反而会觉得被冒犯。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom28
: Why are you talking to me like that?...What have I ever done to you?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要这么跟我说话？……我到底做过什么对不起你的事？

lines.en: : What? I’m not trying to be rude or anything. I like you a lot, Karin. I just want to help you get your story straight for when he walks through the door and you can’t get a single sentence out.
lines.zh: : 什么？我又不是要无礼什么的。我很喜欢你的，Karin。我只是想帮你把说辞理顺，免得他一进门你一句话都说不出来。

lines.en: : No, you’re trying to start an argument. I’ve lived with Kirin long enough to know antagonization when I hear it.
lines.zh: : 不，你就是想挑起争吵。我跟 Kirin 住了这么久，一听就知道什么是挑衅。

lines.en: : So you can pretend it’s out of the kindness of your heart or that you’ll be {i}accepting{/i} of any feelings I have for him all you want. I know it’s not true.
lines.zh: : 你可以随便装作这是出于好心，或者装作你能{i}接受{/i}我对他的任何感情。我知道那不是真的。

lines.en: : You’re {i}upset{/i} that I’m here. You’re upset that {i}you’re{/i} not involved, so you’re involving yourself. {i}You{/i} admit it.
lines.zh: : 你在{i}不高兴{/i}我在这儿。你在不高兴{i}自己{/i}被排除在外，所以你要把自己搅进来。{i}你{/i}承认吧。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom29
: Wow.
: I guess {i}you’ve{/i} changed too, huh?
lines.zh: : 我看{i}你{/i}也变了，是吧？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom30
: I’m just tired of everyone pretending they know me better than I do.
lines.zh: : 我只是受够了所有人都装作比我更了解我自己。

lines.en: : I’m not an idiot. I’m just...nervous.
lines.zh: : 我不是傻子。我只是……紧张。

lines.en: : And maybe I’m too {i}traditional{/i} or something, but I think it’s completely normal to be reserved about things like...love and...s...sex when it’s the first time I’m ever dealing with them.
lines.zh: : 也许我太{i}保守{/i}了什么的，但我觉得，在第一次面对……爱情，还有……性……这种事的时候，表现得矜持一点，是完全正常的。

lines.en: : I don’t understand when everyone else became so open, but...I’m not going to let you make me feel bad for just being...different.
lines.zh: : 我不明白别人是什么时候变得这么开放的，但……我不会让你因为我「不一样」就让我难堪。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to feel bad, Karin. In fact, I kind of wish you were {i}my{/i} older sister instead of Kirin’s.
lines.zh: : 我不想让你难堪，Karin。事实上，我有点希望你是{i}我的{/i}姐姐，而不是 Kirin 的。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom31
: What? Since when? You’ve never told me anything like that.
lines.zh: : 什么？从什么时候开始的？你从来没跟我说过这种话。

lines.en: : I’m not sure, actually. I just see how much you love her and think it would be nice if anyone showed me that much love.
lines.zh: : 其实我也不确定。我只是看到你有多爱她，就想，要是也有人这么爱我就好了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom32
: Like, even my dad makes it hard to feel like I’m loved sometimes. He’s reserved too. Just the kind of reserved where he doesn’t really show his emotions unless they’re forced out of him.
lines.zh: : 比如，就连我爸有时候都很难让我觉得自己被爱着。他也很内敛。只是他那种内敛是——除非情绪被逼出来，否则他基本不流露。

lines.en: : But you’re different. Everyone always knows exactly how you’re feeling because you don’t really make a big effort to hide it.
lines.zh: : 可你不一样。谁都清楚你现在是什么感受，因为你根本没怎么费劲去藏。

lines.en: : Noriko’s like that too. Cross that with the whole selflessness thing and it’s pretty obvious why your sister gets along with her so well.
lines.zh: : Noriko 也是这样。再加上那股无私劲儿，你妹妹为什么跟她那么合得来就很明显了。

lines.en: : I just think it’d be nice to have a person like that in my life. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，我生命里要是有那样一个人就好了。就这样。

lines.en: : Well, you have Ayane, don’t you? You guys have always seemed like sisters to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你不是有 Ayane 吗？你们俩在我看来一直像姐妹一样。

lines.en: : It feels that way sometimes. It’ll never be real, though. It’s different when you share blood, I think.
lines.zh: : 有时候是那样。不过那永远不是真的。我觉得，有血缘关系是不一样的。

lines.en: : Just ignore me. And thank you for calling me out. I needed that.
lines.zh: : 别理我。还有谢谢你点醒我。我需要这些话。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom33
: I’m sorry for accusing you of wanting to fuck my dad.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我不该说你想跟我爸上床。

lines.en: : Please stop using such vulgar language or I will be forced to bonk you.
lines.zh: : 请别再用这么粗俗的字眼，否则我只好敲你了。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom34
: Deal. We can just hang out in here and drink tea until he comes home. After that, it’s all on him and I’ll only be {i}loosely{/i} involved in the process.
lines.zh: : 成交。我们就在这儿喝茶等他回来。之后就全看他了，我只会在旁边{i}松散{/i}地参与一下。

lines.en: : There’s no need for you to be involved at all, Ami. But thank you.
lines.zh: : 你根本不需要参与，Ami。不过谢谢你。

lines.en: : Not even a little? Are you sure? I’m great for moral support when I’m on your side.
lines.zh: : 一点都不需要？你确定？只要我站在你这边，我给人打气可厉害了。

lines.en: : Yes, but the idea that you’d ever be on {i}my{/i} side when your dad is involved is just crazy talk.
lines.zh: : 是的，不过只要牵扯到你爸，你会站{i}我{/i}这边的想法根本就是天方夜谭。

lines.en: : Oh, hey. I’m great at that too. Maybe you’ll have a use for me after all?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。那个我也很在行。也许你最后还是用得上我？

lines.en: scene karinamiroom35
: Or maybe you can just let me handle this...
lines.zh: : 或者你也可以就让我自己来处理……

lines.en: : I’ve always known the day would come when I need to confront the boy my little sister likes about his {i}intentions{/i} with her. I just always figured he would be her age.
lines.zh: : 我一直知道，总有一天我得去找我妹妹喜欢的那个男生，问问他对她有什么{i}打算{/i}。只是我一直以为，那男生会跟她同岁。

lines.en: : Well, that’s your first mistake. Kirin’s pretty open about her lust for adults. This is on you for ignoring all the signs.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这是你的第一个错误。Kirin 对成年人的欲望可是毫不掩饰的。你无视了所有这些信号，怪你自己。

lines.en: : What’s really sad is that I often feel the same way. That maybe {i}all{/i} of this could have been avoided if I was just a little more assertive as an older sister.
lines.zh: : 真正可悲的是，我常常也有同感。也许只要我这个当姐姐的再强势一点，{i}这一切{/i}本来都能避免。

lines.en: : That’s just...hard for me, though. Especially when I can’t even be assertive when it comes to my {i}own{/i} wants and needs.
lines.zh: : 不过那对我来说……很难。尤其是连面对{i}自己{/i}的需求和渴望时，我都强势不起来。

lines.en: scene karinamiroom36
: That’s why you’ve gotta be more like me! There’s not really {i}anything{/i} I wouldn’t do to make sure my story goes on at this point.
lines.zh: : 所以你得更像我才行！到这地步，为了让我的故事继续下去，真的没有{i}什么{/i}事是我做不出来的。

lines.en: : Your story’s just beginning, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你的故事才刚开始，Ami。

lines.en: : God, I hope not. If this is just the beginning, I can only imagine what horrors have yet to come.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我希望不是。如果这才只是开始，我简直不敢想象后面还有什么恐怖的事。

lines.en: : Trust me. Things will only get worse and...
lines.zh: : 相信我。事情只会变得更糟，而且……

lines.en: scene karinamiroom37
: {i}Haaaaaah...{/i}
scene karinamiroom38
: Excuse me. I’m just...so exhausted.
lines.zh: : 不好意思。我只是……太累了。

lines.en: : Just how chaotic has your sleep schedule been, exactly? Because I know the doctors say to shoot for eight, but you should be fine with six or even {i}five{/i} hours so long as that becomes regular for you.
lines.zh: : 你的作息到底乱成什么样了？我知道医生说要八小时，不过只要你固定下来，六小时甚至{i}五{/i}小时应该也没问题。

lines.en: : Maybe four? Or...three? I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 大概四小时？或者……三小时？我不知道……

lines.en: : Do you have a pillow or something?...Do you mind if I just sort of...nap until Sensei gets here?
lines.zh: : 你有枕头什么的吗？……我能不能就……先睡一会儿，等 Sensei 回来？

lines.en: : Mhm. You can use the bed if you want. I’ll tuck you in and everything!
lines.zh: : 嗯。你想的话可以用床。我会给你盖好被子的，全套服务！

lines.en: scene karinamiroom39
: Thank you...Ami...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……Ami……

lines.en: : That’s...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : That’s...really...
: Huh...
: I feel...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……

lines.en: scene karinamiroom40
scene karinamiroom41
: (Sips incestuously)
lines.zh: （乱伦地啜了一口）
